name: What is involved in the reverse osmosis system installation process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the reverse osmosis system installation process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The reverse osmosis system installation process typically involves several key steps. First, we select the optimal location, usually under the kitchen sink, to ensure easy access for maintenance and connection to the main cold water line. We then install a dedicated drinking water faucet on your countertop and connect the system to your drain line for wastewater disposal. The complexity can increase if custom drilling is required for the faucet or if your plumbing setup needs adjustments. Providing clear access to the under-sink area beforehand can help streamline the installation and ensure a smoother, more efficient process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves connecting the RO system to your cold water line, installing a dedicated faucet, and connecting to the drain. Clear under-sink access aids the process.
